sloka: तं विभीषणसुग्रीवौ हनुमान् जाम्बवान्नलः ।ऋक्षराजस्तथा नीलो लक्ष्मणश्चान्वयुस्तदा ।। ६.४१.२६ ।।।।
transliteration: taṁ vibhīṣaṇasugrīvau hanumān jāmbavānnalaḥ ।ṛkṣarājastathā nīlo lakṣmaṇaścānvayustadā ।। 6.41.26 ।।।।

translations.english: Surrounded by a large army in front, the broad shouldered Rama proceeded towards Lanka.
